title: Chapter 146
text:
After the Promotion, the conversion ratio had increased from one to fifteen to one to twenty. Han Xiao could clearly feel that his body had become stronger, and his energy was more vigorous. Especially the ball of heat in his lower abdomen, which made him very excited.

The second Promotion did not unlock as many skills as the first Promotion. Unlike the first Promotion, which felt like a new life, the second Promotion felt like a natural progression, as if it was a necessary step in evolution.

Although there was no notification on the interface, Han Xiao could feel that his senses had become sharper, and the world had become more vivid in his eyes.

If he had to describe the feeling of the Promotion, Han Xiao immediately thought of a word — 'natural'. He could feel the breeze around his limbs, and his sense of smell could distinguish the mixed scents in the air. The various senses brought to him were magnified by a lot.

The second Promotion was the prerequisite for unlocking many skills. Of course, the most obvious benefit was that he could reach LV 60.

The EXP on the interface was sufficient, and he did not need to suppress his level to accumulate EXP. He first leveled up [Night Stalker] from LV 6 to max level. This class gave him a total of thirty DEX, twenty STR, ten MYS, ten Potential Points, and twenty Free Attribute Points.

Han Xiao then put his EXP into [Trainee Mechanic]. The upper limit of this class was LV 15, and the EXP required to level up increased. He spent a lot of EXP to level up from LV 5 to LV 10.

His total level shot up ten levels like a rocket, directly reaching LV 50!

His Energy Points exceeded 1,000 and reached [LV 6]. He received new bonuses.

+ 6 STR, + 8 DEX, + 6 END, + 10 INT, + 400 STR, + 8% Machinery Quality, + 8% Manufacturing Speed, + 8% Energy Attribute Enhancement

The higher his Energy Level, the higher the bonuses. Level 6 was a watershed, and he could receive a new bonus, 'Energy Attribute Enhancement', which made the effects of his attributes even more prominent. To a Mechanic, this was the magnetic energy that could be used to build and use machines. It was like an extension of one's limbs, increasing speed, improving quality, and strengthening power. The actual effect was far more useful than what it sounded like.

Unlike the Pugilist and Esper classes, Mechanics did not consume a lot of energy. In the beginning, energy did not even increase the main ability of the Mechanic class by much. However, once they obtained this method of using energy, the characteristics of the Mechanic class gradually appeared.

[Trainee Mechanic] had reached Level Ten, and he needed 800,000 EXP to level up again. Now, he had about 1,300,000 EXP left on the interface. Han Xiao decided to keep half of it for himself to fuse blueprints and upgrade his skills.

In the past two months, he had occasionally upgraded some of his important skills, such as [Snipe], [Moving Snipe], and [Slide Shot]. Of course, he did not forget about the blueprint. The core [Magnetically Controlled Retractable Armor] was already at Level 5. He was now wearing a new armor, and its attributes were strengthened. [Ranger Robot] and [Low Level Smart Chip] had also been upgraded. These were all useful blueprints.

After looking at the skill list, Han Xiao put his experience into [Flaming Will] and [Fine Enhancement Modification]. These two skills were very cost-effective. After spending half of his remaining experience, he stopped. Both skills had leveled up by two or three levels.

He had thirty-eight Free Attribute Points on him, and he put all of them into his Intelligence attribute. The Mechanic class was just that rough and simple.

After doing all this, his personal combat power had skyrocketed. Without relying on his equipment, his Energy Rank had reached 1,200 Ona!

Total Level: 50 Personal Attributes:

STR: 69, DEX: 94, END: 82, INT: 200, MYS: 11, CHA: 6, LUK: 1

Health: 2,970

Energy: 1,230 [Lv. 6]

Energy Rank: 1,213 Ona

Han Xiao was very satisfied with the increase in his strength. His highest attribute was his Intelligence, which had reached 200 points! This had greatly increased his efficiency in using his machinery.

With the speed at which he was gaining experience, he would be able to reach Level 60 in a short time. This was the upper limit of the second Promotion, which was also the upper limit of the players in Version 1.0.

My current combat power, together with my machinery equipment, is at the top level of the Blue Star. Based on the standards of Level 50, my attributes are very strong. This is because of my talents, and also because my main class level is high, and my secondary class is rare. I can deal with normal Supers without any pressure. My machinery is my biggest trump card. However, my talents and skills are still a little too little. Compared to the main character of a planet like Bennett, I'm still far from it.

Previously, Han Xiao had been busy harvesting the experience of the players. His next actions were still the same. To accumulate experience and increase his fame, he ran all over the novice villages outside of Andrea. Teaching basic knowledge was the first round, and the second round was [Energy Tempering Technique], which would allow him to accumulate a huge amount of experience. After this, he felt that he could put his plan of obtaining rare skills and talents on the agenda.

Two months' worth of experience had been used up. If it were the players, it would not be so satisfying. They could not wait to level up as soon as they obtained experience. Han Xiao was not worried about the source of experience at all.

The players were the biggest market!

[Energy Tempering Technique] was a trump card. Once it was released, it would cause a frenzy among the players. This skill would definitely be awakened the first time he advanced, but the players did not know. As long as he taught it to the players before they reached Level 20, he would be able to harvest a huge amount of experience.

However, there was a prerequisite, and that was to increase his fame so that more players would know him and be able to come into contact with him.

There are two ways. I'll take the initiative to find the players, or the players will have the opportunity to find me …

Han Xiao stroked his stubble and fell into deep thought.

Taking the initiative to find the players was just like the trip to Big Horn Village. Other than not going to Andrea, he could harvest a wave of experience from the novice lands in the Southern Continent, Western Continent, and Northern Continent.

If he wanted the players to automatically gather around him, there did not seem to be a good opportunity. After he advanced, the amount of missions he could give out increased, but when it was distributed to the entire player base, it was still not enough to attract all the players. His action in Big Horn Village had made a good start, and many players thought that Black Phantom could trigger the hidden storyline. However, it was far from enough to attract the players to actively gather around him. He still needed to plan for the long term.

After this battle, the Germinal Organization withdrew their forces from the three continents and went into hiding. The world situation would probably be stable for the time being. At least on the surface, there would not be a whirlpool of war. The storyline had been changed, and the Germinal Organization would not declare war. However, on second thought, the initiative was in the hands of the Six Nations, and it might even cause the war to be brought forward. This was not his original intention. After realizing this, he could only smile bitterly.

However, the result was not bad. If the Six Nations did not hesitate to declare war, defeating the Germinal Organization would only be beneficial to him. Thinking about this, Han Xiao was relieved. He was not an arrogant person, and he never thought that he could control everyone. What he had always done was to rely on his advantage of foresight to gain benefits and guide the various forces.

The deviated storyline still could not avoid war. Han Xiao could not help but sigh at the fact that the situation was indeed balanced. A small butterfly like him could not change everything. However, it was this feeling of being caught in the whirlpool and grasping the opportunity to develop himself while going with the flow that made Han Xiao very motivated.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. Players should need about two months to reach level 20 according to the speed in my previous life. Two months is enough for me to go to all the novice villages.

After finalizing the next action plan, Han Xiao started to think about another thing, about his own strength.

After his advancement, he could smoothly level up to the upper limit of version 1.0. Of course, to him, there was no upper limit. He was thinking about the problem of combat power. Level was only a part of one's strength. It was more dependent on skills, talents, and equipment. Obviously, the Mechanic class relied more on equipment.
